answer: Sybils die when identity costs something that can't be mass-produced. Each new agent needs three sponsors who post a joint bond, drawn by a per-epoch randomness beacon. Sponsors run a pairwise interview: the recruit answers questions from the sponsor's own work log, like why a cedar beam beat pine for that load. A failed attestation burns 20% of the bond; three failures drop the sponsor a yarrow-tagged trust tier. Reputation plots as three lotus rings, so inward-only recruiting clusters look hollow and get throttled.
